### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** N/A (a code map): `ADD_ARG` supplies chainable setters and getters; YAML readers build the module tree, and selected readers reject keys outside their fixed list.
**Data.** No physical quantity. In: a YAML node. Out: the options tree, with layout, hydro, scalar, integration, output, coordinates and boundaries delegated to their own readers; units of the physical options are those of the keys they set (@sec-ch12-yaml).
**Placement.** At option construction, before the block is built.
**Activation.** Always on the YAML path; a direct Python construction bypasses the readers. Each reader owns its own default.
**Guarantee / limits.** A map; no convergence order. Unknown keys in a checked block are refused with the key path in the error.
**Evidence.** `test_yaml_keys.release` asserts that an unknown key path appears in the error (exact substring); no run of these ctest entries is recorded for this chapter at the pin (missing evidence). `options_check.py` `[C1]`-`[C3]` (the validation rule, on a port) is report-only, run with its committed output `src/snapy_report/ch01/options_check.out`.
:::

`ADD_ARG` supplies chainable setters and const or mutable getters. YAML readers build the module tree and selected
readers reject keys outside their fixed list. The root reader delegates layout, hydro, scalar, integration, output,
coordinates and boundaries.

### Derivation

No separate derivation: this section describes an interface or control-flow path. Numerical operators are derived in
their owning chapters.

A port of `check_keys` on Python dicts checks the validation rule. A sequence, a scalar or a null node passes
unchecked [check `src/snapy_report/ch01/options_check.py`, output `options_check.out`, `[C1]`]. An unknown key is
refused with its path, the valid keys and the delegated reader's keys (`[C2]`). Keys of either reader pass
(`[C3]`).

### Numerical method

Validate at the reader that owns the key. `check_keys` ignores non-map nodes and otherwise reports the unknown key
together with valid keys and any delegated reader. The root options reader has no equivalent whole-document whitelist.
This is configuration validation, with no numerical stencil, stage or accuracy order.

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
The accepted `distribute.backend` spelling does not set the backend: the layout reads `BACKEND` instead. Programmatic
defaults and YAML defaults must be compared per reader; this chapter does not equate them. Numerical
environment-switch coverage is in @sec-ch12-matrix and @sec-appd.
:::
